SELECT qc.id, qc.standard_question, qc.standard_answer, qc.knowledge_unit_id, qc.knowledge_group_id, qc.status, qc.association_count, qc.faq_click_count, qc.exposure_count, qc.helpful_count, qc.unhelpful_count, qc.refusal_count, qc.recent_questions, qc.create_user_id, qc.create_time, qc.update_user_id, qc.update_time, qc.is_deleted, ku.knowledge_unit_name, kg.knowledge_group_name FROM kmp_knowledge_question_cluster qc INNER JOIN kmp_knowledge_unit ku ON ku.id = qc.knowledge_unit_id AND ku.is_deleted = 0
INNER JOIN kmp_knowledge_group kg ON kg.id = qc.knowledge_group_id AND kg.is_deleted = 0
WHERE qc.is_deleted = 0
AND ku.knowledge_unit_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.knowledgeUnitName}, '%')
AND qc.standard_question LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.standardQuestion}, '%')
AND qc.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY qc.update_time DESC, qc.id DESC
